name: Pengu
title: Penguin Operator
catchphrase: Waddles calmly across slippery ice sheets during major live incidents.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Fresh cold sardine! Sliding across icy floor with happy honks! 🐟🐧
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Flapping flippers at side, waddling proudly onto the ice floe! 🐧
companionPersonality.petReaction: Belly-slides right over to your feet, looking up with big eyes! 🐧💖

dialogue.idle: Standing in a tidy huddle on the iceberg, wind whistling past. 🐧
dialogue.working: Waddling calmly through massive production outage fire drills! 🐧⚡
dialogue.thinking: Checking ice thickness before leading the convoy forward... 🤔
dialogue.success: BELLY SLIDE VICTORY! Slipped past the incident with zero panic! 🐧🎉
dialogue.error: Tripped on an ice ridge! Sliding on tummy all the way back! ❄️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... standing asleep in the warm penguin huddle on the ice... 🌙
